notes_for_editor: Single substantive source (NHLR detail page). The Forest Lookouts page is a header only and firelookout.org is a list. The brief elevation (2527.1 m), 1955 build year and BIA agency all match NHLR, so no corrections. No staffing, access level or visiting information was found, so no access key is recorded; the story points readers to the BIA rather than stating an access level. The story is short because the evidence is short. Fact-check 2026-10-08: removed the unsupported 'beside it' placement of the ground house and the first-person wording; no factual errors found.
